Native form posts (password change, reboot, reset, backup, upgrade) are defined only in the markup.

sources.ref: Captured replies quoted per endpoint under 'evidence'
sources.notes: Every getter in this document was captured from a running unit.

provenance.notes: This unit has no USB port and the build sets CONFIG_USB_MODULES="n", so the whole USB subsystem is compiled out; every getter above answers 'Form <Name> is not defined'. They are listed so a client can explain the gap instead of retrying. The blacklist and the MAC-filter list are two different lists and must not be conflated.

identify.notes: deviceName is present on this build. status.system's adv_firm_ver is the authoritative firmware string and must be compared against matchPrefix before any write endpoint is used.

errorCodes.notes: Generic refusal, or 'list full' on blacklist and parental endpoints.
On nat.dmz.set specifically: the DMZ host equals the LAN address.

envelopes.notes: errCode arrives as an unquoted JSON number; the vendor JS compares it loosely. Endpoints in nonJsonEndpoints answer with a redirect or HTML and must not be parsed as JSON.
